 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Tennessee Titans released defensive lineman Jordan Elliott on Oct. 20 following an incident at the team facility on Oct. 15, the team said in a statement.
 "On Thursday, October 15, there was an incident at our team facility involving Jordan Elliott," the statement said. "Following our review of the incident, we have made the decision to release Elliott from our roster. We will have no further comment on the matter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Elliott has appeared in five games with one start this season. He has 11 tackles.
 This story will be updated. 
 Tyler Palmateer covers the Tennessee Titans for The Tennessean. Have a story idea for Tyler? Reach him at tpalmateer@tennessean.com and on the X platform, @tpalmateer83 .
